prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Create ONE full-body transparent visual novel game sprite by editing the supplied original project NAI master. Preserve EXACT same face proportions, eye color, hair silhouette/parting/accessories, costume, trim/buttons, socks/shoes and body proportions. Match its crisp variable ink contours, patterned hard cel shadows and subdued palette; no redesign or soft airbrush. New acting C08: careful thinking, fingers near chin, gaze slightly aside, no invented object.  Entire body, top hair and both shoes inside empty transparent safe margins. One character only, anatomically correct hands. No scenery, glow, vignette, cast shadow, lettering, logos or furniture. No duplicate accessories, tools, weapons, fire or magic. Genuine transparent alpha outside silhouette. Portrait 1024x1536. Amber eyes. Notebook may be held CLOSED or pocketed; exactly one pink notebook, pocket pen and one attached rabbit keychain. Plain knee socks, no buckles.
origin: one NAI master per character; does not use rejected NAI pose candidates
actual_prompt_extra: Plain ribbed socks ONLY with absolutely no buckles, clips or metal decorations. Keep notebook closed in the existing left pocket if hands needed for acting; never hang a notebook from keychain.
